Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for signing — excited to get started. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation milestones we discussed: phased rollout, canary window, migration cutover and training schedule. High-level asks below so we can lock dates this week: 

- Confirm the 2-week canary window preference (we've proposed Feb 12–25).
- Provide list of 6 initial pilot users for training + UAT access by Feb 5.
- Share SSO metadata and a point-of-contact for security questionnaire (we have a short SOC2 checklist).

Attachment: Marscove_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with milestone dates, owners)

What I want to do next: we’ll run a 2-week canary on a mirrored subset of traffic, followed by a staged migration (30% → 60% → 100%) with automatic fallback to the previous model variant. Training for product+ops is scheduled the week before canary start — 2 instructor-led sessions and 3 office hours.

If all good, I’ll send a calendar for a 30-minute kickoff and assign mutual owners in HubSpot.

Cheers,
Priyom

Thanks — quick operational notes from our side: 

- Training: two instructor-led sessions are 90 min each (recorded). Then three 60-min office hours over the following week. We’ll share slide deck and short cheat-sheet (runbook).
- Canary: we run continuous monitoring on latency, error rate, and a small quality evaluation suite tied to your acceptance prompts. We have an automated rollback policy you can opt into: if any of the three SLOs exceed thresholds for 15 minutes, traffic shifts back to the prior model variant and we notify both teams. We also support manual rollback via the console if you prefer control.
- Resource ask: recommend a reserved 2-GPU slot for the canary duration to avoid noisy-neighbor effects. I attached a short runbook and proposed monitoring thresholds.

Attachment: canary-runbook.xlsx (monitoring thresholds, rollback playbook)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMarscoveOnboard

Action items for Redwood:
- Confirm reserved capacity allocation and cost estimate by EOD Wed (internal ops to confirm).
- Prep instructor deck and UAT credentials.

Action items for Marscove:
- Send pilot user list and SSO metadata.
- Confirm whether you want auto-rollback turned on for canary.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Great — aligned. Summary and next steps (mutual action items):

1) Kickoff: 30-min kickoff — proposed Thu Jan 25 10:00–10:30 PT (I’ll send calendar invite).
2) Pilot users: Elaine to provide list by Tue Jan 22 (received: confirm when you share).
3) SSO & security: ops@marscove.com to upload SSO metadata + completed SOC2 checklist to the Drive folder by Feb 2.
4) Canary window: Feb 12–25 (2-week window) — Redwood to reserve a 2-GPU slot for the window; Ben to share cost delta by EOD Wed.
5) Training: Two 90-min instructor sessions on Feb 8–9, followed by 3 one-hour office hours Feb 12–16. Deck and cheat-sheet will be posted in Drive.
6) Monitoring & rollback: Auto-rollback is ON by default for the canary; please confirm if you want to opt out by Feb 5. Thresholds: latency > 350ms p95, error rate > 0.8%, quality drift > 3% on acceptance prompts triggers rollback.
